about: [C8 critic] the chapter as it flows (no jumps): the nick by the window, Dot lays the gun (E to take it), the headlamps, the first cars and their men - frames at each moment; then hands off.

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, e = G.eye, p = {x:-10.2,z:-3.8}; const wy = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)); const wp = Math.atan2(1.3 - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(wy - C.yaw), Math.cos(wy - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(wp - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()

steps.eval: JSON.stringify({ cur: G.interact.current && G.interact.current.id, prompt: G.hud.promptShown || null, warn: G.hud.kit.warnText || null })
JSON.stringify({ pos: [N.controller.pos.x.toFixed(2), N.controller.pos.z.toFixed(2)], crouch: !!(N.controller.sneak && N.controller.sneak.crouch), mode: N.controller.mode })

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, e = G.eye, p = G.b7.gun.group.position; const wy = Math.atan2(-(p.x - e.x), -(p.z - e.z)); const wp = Math.atan2(1.25 - e.y, Math.hypot(p.x - e.x, p.z - e.z)); const dy = Math.atan2(Math.sin(wy - C.yaw), Math.cos(wy - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-dy / C.sensitivity), Math.round(-(wp - C.pitch) / C.sensitivity)]; })()
